title: The Lord Appears to Solomon

questions.question: How many times had the Lord appeared to Solomon?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 9:2 (ESV): "...the LORD appeared to Solomon a second time, as he had appeared to him at Gibeon."

questions.question: What warning did God give Solomon?
options: If you turn aside from following me, I will cut off Israel
questions.correctAnswer: If you turn aside from following me, I will cut off Israel
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 9:6-7 (ESV): "But if you turn aside from following me... then I will cut off Israel from the land..."

questions.question: What did Hiram call the cities Solomon gave him?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 9:13 (ESV): "'What kind of cities are these that you have given me, my brother?' So they are called the land of Cabul to this day."

questions.question: Who did Solomon use for forced labor?
options: Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites
questions.correctAnswer: Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 9:20-21 (ESV): "All the people who were left of the Amorites... Solomon drafted to be slaves..."

questions.question: What did Solomon NOT make the people of Israel do?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 9:22 (ESV): "But of the people of Israel Solomon made no slaves. They were the soldiers..."

questions.question: What did Solomon build at Ezion-geber?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 9:26 (ESV): "King Solomon built a fleet of ships at Ezion-geber..."

questions.question: How many talents of gold did they bring from Ophir?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 9:28 (ESV): "And they went to Ophir and brought from there gold, 420 talents..."

questions.question: Who did Pharaoh's daughter move out of the city of David to?
options: Her own house which Solomon had built for her
questions.correctAnswer: Her own house which Solomon had built for her
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 9:24 (ESV): "But Pharaoh's daughter went up from the city of David to her own house that Solomon had built for her..."

questions.question: How many cities did Solomon give Hiram?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 9:11 (ESV): "...King Solomon gave to Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee."

questions.question: What structures did Solomon build with the forced labor (Millo)?
options: The house of the Lord, his own house, the Millo, and the wall of Jerusalem
questions.correctAnswer: The house of the Lord, his own house, the Millo, and the wall of Jerusalem
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 9:15 (ESV): "...to build the house of the LORD and his own house and the Millo and the wall of Jerusalem..."

questions.question: Why did Pharaoh capture Gezer?
options: To give it as a dowry to his daughter
questions.correctAnswer: To give it as a dowry to his daughter
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 9:16 (ESV): "Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up and captured Gezer... and given it as a dowry to his daughter, Solomon's wife."

questions.question: How many times a year did Solomon offer sacrifices on the altar?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 9:25 (ESV): "Three times a year Solomon used to offer up burnt offerings and peace offerings..."

questions.question: Who did Hiram send with the fleet?
options: His servants, seamen who were familiar with the sea
questions.correctAnswer: His servants, seamen who were familiar with the sea
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 9:27 (ESV): "And Hiram sent with the fleet his servants, seamen who were familiar with the sea..."

questions.question: Solomon did what to the house (Temple) after finishing it?
Where is Ezion-geber located?
options: Near Eloth on the shore of the Red Sea, in the land of Edom
questions.correctAnswer: Near Eloth on the shore of the Red Sea, in the land of Edom
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 9:26 (ESV): "...at Ezion-geber, which is near Eloth on the shore of the Red Sea, in the land of Edom."

key_verse_text: And as for you, if you will walk before me, as David your father walked, with integrity of heart and uprightness, doing according to all that I have commanded you, and keeping my statutes and my rules, (ESV)
